findings.where: outer sides of both yellow sneakers
findings.evidence: Each sneaker carries an embossed swoosh-style brand mark, and the spec forbids any logo.
Small rectangular tan tabs on both tongues read as brand label patches, and the spec forbids labels.
The arms hang nearly straight down close to the torso instead of the requested 25-degree A pose, which reduces silhouette separation for 3D modeling.
The ears are tall, pointed and fairly thin-rimmed rather than the requested short thick triangular ears.
The tail sweeps out to the side past the leg instead of being kept close behind the body.
